name: agentsims
description: Run and control local iOS simulators and Android devices with Agentsims, in the Codex in-app browser.

interface.longDescription: Open the Agentsims workspace in the in-app browser to see and control iOS simulators and Android devices. The agent uses the agentsims CLI to tap, type, inspect the screen, install apps, and read logs.
defaultPrompt: Run an end-to-end test of the app on the Pixel 10 and iPhone 18 simulators.
